races.title: Annual Members At Huntingdon Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: He may well have been no match for an odds-on favourite on his recent hurdling debut, but MY MATE AJ showed plenty to work on, so he gets the verdict to go a place better for the in-form Ben Pauling yard. The obvious danger is Double The Dance , who found one too strong in all 3 bumper starts last season and should make his mark as a hurdler. Talladale may prove best of the rest. MY MATE AJ (IRE) DOUBLE THE DANCE (IRE) TALLADALE

races.title: Conferences At Huntingdon 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CRYSTAL ISLAND arrives unbeaten having won an Irish point and both starts over hurdles and he looks the type to go on to even better things as a staying chaser. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate Reckless Spending , who also remains with potential as he makes the switch to chasing. CRYSTAL ISLAND (IRE) RECKLESS SPENDING (IRE) JOHN BARBOUR

races.title: Book Hospitality At Huntingdon Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The tentative nod goes to JAMADA , who made a reasonably encouraging start over fences when fourth at Worcester recently and Olly Murphy's 6-y-o is open to improvement, especially if brushing up his jumping. Inside Man showed much more what he's about when runner-up at Chepstow earlier in the month, so he looks a big threat, with Sweeper System rounding off the shortlist. JAMADA (IRE) INSIDE MAN (FR) SWEEPER SYSTEM (IRE)

races.title: Festive Fiver Raceday 21 December Mares' Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: This can go the way of LETS GO MO , who shaped encouragingly switched to a handicap after 8 months off when finding just one too strong at Lingfield recently and Lucy Wadham's filly looks capable of better again. Palma Springs represents a yard firing on all cylinders, so she could be the one to provide most resistance, with Bontessony Doll expected to fare better now handicapping over a longer trip. LETS GO MO (IRE) PALMA SPRINGS BONTESSONY DOLL
